datasets.name: fda6d4f4
queryLines:
WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.access_source_table_coverage WHERE status <> 'OK')
SELECT count(*) AS value,
       COALESCE((SELECT concat('Worst: ', schema_name, '.', table_name) FROM s
                 ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lag_days DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1), 'None') AS target

datasets.name: 7bb118e4
queryLines:
WITH c AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT t.*, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_workspace, COALESCE(concat(d_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS n_workspace, COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS nm_warehouse, COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) AS n_warehouse, COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) AS ws_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)) IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) ELSE concat(COALESCE(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, d_warehouse.n), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)), ' · ', COALESCE(d_workspace.n, CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING))) END AS lbl_warehouse FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_audit_self_usage t LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) d_workspace ON d_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) d_warehouse ON d_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND d_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)) WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(ws_name, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all')))
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(est_audit_usd_list) FROM c), 0) * (1.0 - 0.0), 2) AS value,
       concat(CAST(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(matched_statement_count) FROM c), 0) AS STRING), ' queries, ',
              CAST((SELECT count(*) FROM c) AS STRING), ' warehouses, list price') AS target

datasets.name: 00b66f73
queryLines:
SELECT status, concat(schema_name, '.', table_name) AS source, rows_in_window, total_row_count,
       COALESCE(min_time, '-') AS min_time, COALESCE(max_time, '-') AS max_time,
       COALESCE(lag_days, -1) AS lag_days, days_with_data_in_window
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.access_source_table_coverage
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, total_row_count ASC
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: 52fd434e
queryLines:
SELECT c.title AS check_title,
       c.page AS page,
       CASE WHEN l.query_id IS NULL THEN 'Not run'
            WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 'Not assessed'
            WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 'Warn'
            WHEN l.has_status THEN 'OK'
            WHEN l.row_count = 0 THEN 'No rows'
            ELSE 'Listed' END AS verdict,
       l.row_count AS row_count,
       l.critical AS critical_rows,
       l.warn AS warn_rows,
       l.error AS error
FROM (VALUES
       (0, 'access_source_table_coverage', 'System table coverage', 'Data sources'),
       (1, 'cost_account_prices_raw', 'Account-specific prices, raw', 'Data sources'),
       (2, 'pricing_list_prices_raw', 'List prices, raw', 'Data sources'),
       (3, 'cost_audit_self_usage', 'This audit\'s own usage, by warehouse', 'Data sources')) AS c(ord, query_id, title, page)
LEFT JOIN databricks_audit_dashboard.snapshot_log l ON l.query_id = c.query_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.critical > 0 THEN 0 WHEN l.warn > 0 THEN 1 WHEN NOT l.ok THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, c.ord

datasets.name: 7c9a59df
queryLines:
SELECT
  t.`status` AS `status`,
  t.`catalog_name` AS `catalog_name`,
  t.`schema_name` AS `schema_name`,
  t.`table_name` AS `table_name`,
  CAST(t.`has_time_column` AS STRING) AS `has_time_column`,
  t.`time_column_name` AS `time_column_name`,
  t.`rows_in_window` AS `rows_in_window`,
  t.`total_row_count` AS `total_row_count`,
  t.`min_time` AS `min_time`,
  t.`max_time` AS `max_time`,
  t.`days_with_data_in_window` AS `days_with_data_in_window`,
  t.`first_date_in_window` AS `first_date_in_window`,
  t.`last_date_in_window` AS `last_date_in_window`,
  t.`lag_days` AS `lag_days`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.access_source_table_coverage t
ORDER BY CASE `status` WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 WHEN 'OK' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, `schema_name` ASC NULLS LAST, `table_name` ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000

datasets.name: bc68fb58
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(concat(n_workspace.n, ' (', CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING), NULL) AS `workspace_shown`,
  COALESCE(concat(COALESCE(t.`warehouse_name`, n_warehouse.n), ' (', CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), ')'), CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING), '(no warehouse)') AS `warehouse_shown`,
  t.`matched_client_application` AS `matched_client_application`,
  t.`matched_statement_count` AS `matched_statement_count`,
  t.`matched_duration_secs` AS `matched_duration_secs`,
  t.`warehouse_all_duration_secs` AS `warehouse_all_duration_secs`,
  t.`matched_share_pct` AS `matched_share_pct`,
  t.`est_usd_list` AS `est_usd_list`,
  t.`est_audit_usd_list` AS `est_audit_usd_list`,
  t.`price_basis` AS `price_basis`,
  date_format(t.`first_query_time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `first_query_time`,
  date_format(t.`last_query_time`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `last_query_time`
FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.cost_audit_self_usage t
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, max(name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_workspace GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING)) n_workspace
  ON n_workspace.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING) AS warehouse_id, max(warehouse_name) AS n FROM databricks_audit_dashboard.dim_warehouse GROUP BY CAST(workspace_id AS STRING), CAST(warehouse_id AS STRING)) n_warehouse
  ON n_warehouse.workspace_id = CAST(t.`workspace_id` AS STRING) AND n_warehouse.warehouse_id = CAST(t.`warehouse_id` AS STRING)
WHERE (array_contains(:workspace, COALESCE(n_workspace.n, '')) OR array_contains(:workspace, 'all'))
ORDER BY `est_audit_usd_list` DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5000

lines: What this shows: what still limits these numbers, beyond the fixed 30-day, list-price window stated on every page.

## Some rankings are by size, not a threshold
Spend by job, spend by cluster or warehouse, and spend by pipeline are ranked by size alone -- they always read Ranked, never Critical or Warn, however big the number.

## Autoscale churn counts events, not time
Warehouse autoscale churn counts how often a warehouse's cluster count changes, not how long it spent scaled up.

## Task memory-pressure rule
A job task is flagged for memory pressure from its 90th-percentile worker memory and swap; the swap threshold defaults to 10% in config/thresholds.yml, so a single brief spike can be enough to flag it.

## Redacted SQL text pools together
When a statement's text is hidden from the export, every redacted statement in the window pools into one heaviest-statement shape instead of being counted separately.
